title: ID0465450-DC/Si-D/FR-[MP / R6 170002081] Issue with CCS1 (Left) Connector
description: Reported Behaviour/ Issue: Issue with CCS1 (Left) Connector

additional_info.subject: Issue with CCS1 (Left) Connector – SID MP/R6 Charger No. 170002081 – WHEELTAINER
additional_info.body:
Hello,
I would like to report a major issue with the SID MP/R6 charger – S/N 170002081 installed at the WHEELTAINER site.
The left CCS connector (CCS1) is no longer functioning properly.
Yesterday at around 10:59, the site manager called me: a Volvo truck that has been on-site for several days could not start a charging session on CCS1.
I walked the driver through a BMS reset on the truck. The charging session does start, but it stops automatically at step 3 every time.
We tried several times — same result.
When we connected the truck to the other connector (CCS2, right side), the charging session launched normally and worked without any issue.
Nicolas, the fleet manager, also tested the CCS1 connector with an Audi, and the result was the same: charging does not start.
Based on early internal feedback (from Franck,
thanks
@Le Gal, Franck
for your quick reply yesterday, very appreciated
), the issue could be related to a faulty contactor on the left connector.
Photos of the connector are attached for reference.
This situation is now affecting operations.
Yesterday evening,
@Nicolas JEAN - WHEELTAINER
had to return to the site at around 23:00 to unplug a fully charged truck from the 160 kW charger and connect another one.
Managing the charging schedule is becoming difficult with one connector out of service.
Please:
•     investigate the issue on CCS1,
•     schedule an urgent on-site intervention,
•     and confirm the expected response time.
Thank you for your quick support.
Kind regards,
Malek DRIF | Head of Operations | Mob:
+33 650 370 485
SAS AUTORECHARGE |
WWW.AUTORECHARGE.FR
|
+33 970 755 400
Design and installation of EV charging equipment and infrastructure
.

﻿from the Technical Support to the eMobility RC-FR SI E Queue. We kindly ask you to take over the case and perform the necessary troubleshooting steps.

Product:

Charger ID / Serial No.:
Charger address/functional location:
Priority:
Medium
Handover reason:
The issue is either with the contactor or the KF13.First, measure the ongoing session with crocodile clips to confirm whether the contactor is closing.
If the contactor is not closing, replace the KF13 first.
If replacing the KF13 does not solve the issue, then replace the contactor.
Kindly pick up the case using "Pick" option in the queue or manually using the "Assign" function from the
eMobility RC-FR SI E Queue
and work on it & document the activity (Logs/Field Service Report) and attach it to the case under Documents Tab on ISP.

unified service process
